DEWALT DCS331N-XJ 18V XR jigsaw delivers versatile, reliable cordless performance for cutting wood, metal, and plastics. Features a robust motor for fast, precise straight and curved cuts, 3-position pendulum action for efficient cutting control, and an adjustable aluminium base for accurate bevel cuts up to 45°. A durable anti-scratch base cover provides protection for work surfaces, and an integrated dust port keeps the cutting line clear and supports dust extraction. Includes keyless, tool-free blade change system to enable quick blade swaps, boosting productivity, and rubber-coated grip for comfort and reduced fatigue during extended use. Compatible with all Dewalt 18V XR Li-Ion batteries and chargers (sold separately).
